title: Invertibility of common-quotient reduced insertion
statement: Let g:J→K preserve finite limits, R→B and g(R)→Bprime be flat, a:g(B)→Bprime compatible, nY,nX normalized scalar extensions, Q a common quotient tower for R→B, and b:Bprime→g(Q.S) a compatible tower of common quotient projections. For any normalized scalar insertion i and every n, whiskering i.derived by derived scalar extension along g(Q.projection n) is invertible in the actual quotient-module derived category.

source.place: Tags 06YY (derived base change), 0G7E (K-flat pullback), 0D6D (composition); sites-modules.tex Tags 03D7, 03EK, 03EL.

proof.text: The ordinary scalar insertion becomes invertible after extension to the common quotient, without any flatness assumption.

Choose a flat-term K-flat B-complex resolving the derived object. Flat restriction and inverse image make the source K-flat with flat terms; ringed pullback and flat restriction do the same for the target.

The normalized counits compute both derived reductions by ordinary scalar extension. Apply the quotient derived functor to the insertion representative square and paste with naturality of its counit. The ordinary reduction is a degreewise chain isomorphism by the first step. Thus reduced insertion becomes an isomorphism after composition with invertible computation maps; cancel those maps.
Essential surjectivity of flat-term K-flat localization and naturality along its representative isomorphisms transfer invertibility to every derived object.

lean.statement:
theorem insertion_finite_isIso [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv]
    (hflat : IsFlatOnSite (J := J) (R := R)
      ((restriction φ).obj (unit ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj B))))
    (hflat' : IsFlatOnSite (J := K) (R := g.rings.obj R)
      ((restriction (g.rings.map φ ≫ a)).obj
        (unit ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj B'))))
    (hquotient : ∀ n : ℕ, IsPushout (g.rings.map φ ≫ a)
      (quotient g φ Q n) (b.app (op n)) (𝟙 _))
    (hcompatible : ∀ n : ℕ, a ≫ b.app (op n) = g.rings.map (Q.extensionProjection n))
    (i : Insertion g nY nX φ a) (n : ℕ) :
    IsIso (Functor.whiskerRight i.derived (pX (quotient g φ Q n)).derived)
